scientific_integrity: The lower bound for odd primes is proved by local reduction, a degree-two residue-field argument, and a commuting-nilpotent-operator obstruction; no independent review. The existence construction adapts the multiplication table of the cited characteristic-two example.
scientific_limitations: Does not classify equality cases in odd characteristic
No claim that the binary minimum was newly proved
The proof concerns finite rings of prime-power cardinality
title: Sharp prime-wise minimum order of noncommutative centrally essential rings
